text: Wind is formless and tangible. It is twofold: eternal and non-eternal. The eternal is atomic in form; the non-eternal is the form of an effect. Again, it is threefold due to the distinction among body, sense organ, and object. The bodily wind is in the realm of air. The sense organ is the faculty of touch, which is the skin pervading the entire body. The object is the movement of trees and the like. || 12 ||
